remarks: Modern Luxury Meets Classic Charm on Elm Place - Experience sophisticated living in this spectacular masterpiece situated on one of the area's most coveted streets, where a dramatic, light-drenched three-story foyer flows effortlessly into a formal dining room and a sprawling front-to-back living room anchored by a classic fireplace. The heart of the home features an open-concept gourmet kitchen and an inviting family room complete with a rugged stone fireplace, custom wet bar, and sunny breakfast nook. Through elegant French doors, the living space extends to an unparalleled outdoor oasis; this private sanctuary is anchored by an expansive stone terrace and a pristine, heated Gunite pool and spa, all framed by lush, professional landscaping and a fully fenced perimeter for ultimate seclusion. The second level is home to a luxurious primary retreat with a gas fireplace, expansive walk-in closets, and a spa-like marble bath, alongside three additional en-suite bedrooms and a convenient laundry room. Versatility abounds on the finished third floor, which offers a dedicated office, family room, and a fifth bedroom, while the lower level provides a spacious gym or media room with integrated cabinetry. Ideally located just moments from award-winning schools, fine dining, and boutique shopping, with easy access to NYC and Boston, this home offers a masterclass in style, privacy, and convenience.
